excluded_with_reasons.ANC/service mediators (all): post-exposure health-service mediators, per Step 2 domain reclassification
excluded_with_reasons.facility_type / delivery_place_code: the exposure itself, not a confounder
excluded_with_reasons.maternal_age: sensitivity-only -- v012 is age at interview, not verified as age at the analyzed birth; not safely derivable as age-at-index-birth from current v2 fields (would need DHS b3/v011 CMC dates, not in v2). age_at_first_birth is exact for birth_order==1 records only.
excluded_with_reasons.bmi: sensitivity-only -- pre-exposure timing relative to the analyzed birth not verified
excluded_with_reasons.health_insurance: sensitivity-only -- pre-exposure timing/uptake relative to facility choice not verified
excluded_with_reasons.total_children_ever_born: excluded -- unresolved timing TODO (survey-date snapshot) from Step 2
excluded_with_reasons.preceding_birth_interval / age_at_first_: optional sensitivity variables -- unresolved DHS special-code TODO from Step 2
excluded_with_reasons.district: optional sensitivity variable -- finer-grained geographic control than the primary state adjustment

propensity_model.primary: LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, random_state=42), fit survey-weighted via sample_weight=sample_weight_normalized, no class rebalancing, no outcome-based tuning

weighting.stabilized_ipw_formula: private: P(private)/e ; public: (1-P(private))/(1-e); P(private) is the survey-weighted marginal prevalence; e itself now comes from a survey-weighted propensity model (Section 4)
weighting.combined_weight_used_for: post-weighting SMD and ESS diagnostics ONLY -- not used to estimate any effect in this notebook

interpretation_rule: Diagnostic only. No causal effect is estimated or implied by this notebook.
